name: imageoptimizer

includes.description: An array of globbing patterns of files/folders to include in the optimization

excludes.description: An array of globbing patterns of files/folders to exclude in the optimization

lossy.description: When set to true, images are compressed a lot more but with a slight quality loss that may not be visible to the human eye.

description:
We've defined two image‑optimization passes for the project. The first pass targets all PNG files under the **src/images** hierarchy (matching `src/images/**/*.png`) as well as every JPG located anywhere within **assets** (`assets/**/*.jpg`). To keep temporary or dependency files untouched, we explicitly exclude anything under `src/images/temp/**` and all contents of `node_modules/**`. This rule applies aggressive, lossy compression, which should noticeably shrink file sizes while preserving visual quality.

The second pass is simpler: it processes every SVG file found in the **icons** folder tree (`icons/**/*.svg`). No additional exclusions are required for this set, and it runs with lossless settings, leaving the SVGs unchanged in quality.
